Cycle 4 ANALYZE_RESULTS: h-cross-utterance-flicker confirmed and stronger than predicted -- cross-batch translation NE ~1.47 (median 1.28) across 275 multi-batch utterance spans (6.2% of all 4471 spans), vs ~0.0001 within-batch. Manually verified against smoketest raw events: cross-batch retranslations are near-total rewrites, not incremental refinement. status=tested. Writing cycle 4 Japanese report next.

Cycle 4 REFLECT: appended reflection entry.
